correctness.rationale: The Heawood graph was reconstructed from seven Fano triples (each point pair appears once) and the two simultaneous three-color threshold-one update rules. The indegree-pruning functional-graph classification computes actual least eventual periods, not just divisors; the independent trajectory-path method uses a different binary-incidence Fano presentation. Both source programs and their full ten joint count output were inspected. Additionally wrote and compiled an independent C++ full-state functional-graph implementation, independently enumerating every one of 3^14=4,782,969 labelled initial states. Its ten period-pair populations match the assigned table exactly: (1,1)240039,(3,3)705474,(4,4)507024,(5,5)105084,(6,6)1283436,(8,4)275520,(8,8)448224,(10,5)237216,(10,10)626136,(14,14)354816. The only mismatches are 8->4 and 10->5 totaling 512736. This is a genuinely exhaustive finite proof for the specified finite graph, not an extrapolation to all graphs.
